europe_now.title: Escalation in Ukraine and Regional Visits
europe_now.summary: The death toll from a Russian attack on an aid distribution point in Ukraine has risen significantly, prompting high-level diplomatic responses. European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen is scheduled to visit the Black Sea region amid a wave of deadly drone attacks.

sources.headline: Death toll rises to 50 in Russian attack on aid distribution ‌point in Ukraine
Von der Leyen to visit Black Sea amid deadly drone attacks

europe_now.title: Mass Demonstrations and Labor Protests in France
europe_now.summary: Large crowds have gathered across France to participate in mass protests demanding higher wages amid a broader context of social unrest. Meanwhile, a fatal school bus accident in eastern France has resulted in multiple casualties and injuries.

sources.headline: Mass protests sweep France as huge crowds demand higher wages
At least two killed, 16 injured in school bus accident in eastern France

top_stories.title: French Political Shifts and Institutional Debates
top_stories.summary: French far-left figures have integrated policies regarding international alliances into their official presidential platform. These developments come as widespread demonstrations continue to impact domestic stability and political discourse across the country.

sources.headline: French far left enshrines leaving NATO in official presidential platform

top_stories.title: European Union Regulatory Actions
top_stories.summary: European authorities have formally accused TikTok of breaching digital rules due to algorithmic design choices. The European Union continues to scrutinize major technology platforms regarding user safety and online behaviors.

sources.headline: EU accuses TikTok of designing algorithm that creates ‘rabbit holes’
